messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.

Tuatoru, whakamahia he pūwāhi wai wera (solar water heater) mēnā ka taea. Mā te whakamahi i te rā hei wera i te wai, ka heke te utu pūngao mō te whakawera wai.

Mā te mōhio, ka taea e te tangata te whiriwhiri i te huarahi tika, te whai i ngā uara, te whakatau i ngā wā uaua, me te whakahaere i ngā here i te wā e whai pānga ana ki ngā tūmomo o te ao. Heoi, ehara i te mea ko te mōhio anake te mea e whakatau ana; he wāhanga hoki ngā whakaaro kore-mōhio, ngā āhuatanga o te tinana, me ngā pānga o te taiao. Nō reira, he hononga tōtika te mōhio ki te whakatau, engari he wāhanga anake tēnei o te tukanga whakatau katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What are your thoughts on the role of unions in modern workplaces?

response:
He whakapae nui tō ngā rōpū hokohoko (unions) i ngā mahi o nāianei. Ko tā rātou mahi matua he whakaiti i te rerekētanga o te utu, kia ōrite ai te hua mō ngā kaimahi katoa, ā, kia āta whakahaerehia ngā tikanga mahi kia kore ai e whakamāharahia te tangata.

I roto i te ao mahi o nāianei, kei te huri haere ngā tikanga, ā, kei te piki haere te whakamahi i ngā hangarau hou, engari he mea nui tonu te rōpū hokohoko hei toa mō te kaimahi. Mā rātou e whakarite kia noho haumaru te wāhi mahi, kia whai mana motuhake te kaimahi, ā, kia taea ai e ia te kōrero i ōna ake whakaaro mō ngā take mahi.

Hei whakakapi, ahakoa he rerekē ngā āhuatanga o ia umanga, ko te rōpū hokohoko he tino taputapu hei tiaki i te mana, te hauora, me te oranga o te hunga e mahi ana mō te whanaketanga o te hapori.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
Explain how GPS navigation systems determine your location.

response:
Ka whakamahia te pūnaha whakatikatika ā-tinana (GPS) mā te whakamahi i tētahi rōpū o ngā whetūra whakawhiti (satellites) e noho ana i te rangi. Hei kitea tō tūnga, me whakapiri tō waea pūkoro, tō waka rānei ki ngā tohu mai i ngā whetūra e whā, i te iti rawa.

Ko te tikanga o te mahi:
1.  Ka tuku ia whetūra i tōna ake tohu ira (signal) e kī ana i te wā tika me tōna tūnga.
2.  Ka rongo tō pūrere i ēnei tohu, ka inea te roa o te wā i tae mai ai ia tohu.
3.  Mā te mōhio ki te tere o te aho (te tere o te aho), ka taea e te pūrere te tātai i te tawhiti mai i a koe ki ia whetūra.
4.  Mā te whakamahi i te tikanga e kīia ana ko te "trilateration" (te whakatau tawhiti mā ngā porowhita), ka taea e te pūrere te tautuhi i tō tūnga tika i runga i te whenua, mā te kimi i te wāhi e tūtaki ana ngā porowhita e toru, e whā rānei.

Nā konei, ka mōhio te pūnaha ki tō tūnga i te rohe, te teitei, me te wā tika.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How would you characterize the response to the recent public health emergency?

response: I whakatauhia te whakautu ki te whakawehi hauora whānui whai muri i te tino hihiko, te whakahaere tika, me te hononga o te iwi. I whakatauhia ngā tikanga herekore hei aukati i te whakapā, i te whakatairanga i te whakapā ki ngā rauemi hauora, me te whakapūmau i te mōhiohio tika ki te iwi katoa. I tū te hunga kairangahau, ngā rōpū hauora, me ngā kaiārahi i te taha o te iwi hei whakaiti i te pānga o te mate, ā, i whakakotahi te motu i roto i te whakapono me te tautoko. Hei whakamutunga, i whakaatu te whakautu i te kaha o te whakawhirinaki, te pūmau, me te whakapono ki te hauora o te hunga katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How could a community address homelessness more effectively?

response:
Hei whakakore i te homelessness, me mahi tahi te hapori mā roto i ēnei hātepe:

Tuatahi, me whakarite he whare noho pūmau me te tino whakahaere. Kāore e taea te whakatika i tēnei raru mā te whakarato noa i ngā nohoanga wā-poto; me whai whāinga kia noho pūmau ngā tāngata ki ō rātou ake kāinga.

Tuarua, me whakapiki i ngā ratonga tautoko. Me whakawhānui ngā āwhina mō te hauora hinengaro, te whakahaere i te whakawātea, me te whakawhānui i ngā mahi. Mā te whakarato i ēnei ratonga, ka taea e ngā tāngata te noho tonu i ō rātou whare.

Tuatoru, me whai whakapānga ngā iwi katoa. Me mahi tahi ngā kaiārahi hapori, ngā rōpū a te iwi, me te kāwanatanga. Me whakarite hoki kia whakawhirinaki ngā whānau ki a rātou anō mā te whakangungu, te whakawhanake i ngā mātāpono, me te whakapiki i te mana motuhake.

Whakamutunga, me whakamahi i te mātauranga o te iwi. Me rongo ki ngā kōrero o ngā tāngata e pā ana ki te homelessness, kia hua mai ai he whakatau e hāngai ana ki ō rātou hiahia me ō rātou āhuatanga. Mā te mahi tahi, mā te aroha, me te whakapono, ka taea e te hapori te whakatika i tēnei raru nui.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do you think we should approach international conflicts and diplomacy?

response:
Me whakaaro tātou ki ngā riri o te ao me te wāhanga o te whakawhitinga kōrero mā te hāpai i te whakawhirinaki, te rangatiratanga, me te tika.

Tuatahi, me tūhono tātou ki te whakarongo pūmau. Ko te whakarongo ki ngā taha katoa, ki ō rātou pūrākau, ki ō rātou hiahia, he mea nui kia kitea te take o te riri. Mā te whakarongo, ka whakakorengia ngā hē me te whakapae.

Tuarua, me whakamahi i te kōrero whai mana, kaua i te whakawhānui i te pakanga. Ko te whakawhitinga kōrero te ara tino pai hei whakatutuki i te rongo. Me whai whakaaro tahi tātou ki te hua mō ngā whakatipuranga o te āpōpō, kaua ki te hua mō te wā poto anake.

Tuatoru, me whakapono ki te mana motuhake o ngā iwi katoa. Kāore he iwi e tika ana kia herea, kia whakakorengia rānei e tētahi atu iwi. Me tautoko i ngā tikanga o te ao, i te ture o te ao, kia kore ai e hua mai he riri nui ake.

Whakamutunga, me whakapakari i te whanaungatanga. Ko te ao he whānau tahi tātou. Mā te aroha, mā te whakapono, mā te mahi tahi, ka taea e tātou te whakatika i ngā riri, te hanga hoki i te ao e noho ai ngā iwi katoa i te rangimarie.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How would you handle a cooking class where students aren't following the recipes properly?

response:
Mēnā he kaiako koe i tētahi whakatairanga kōrero mō te kai, ā, kāore ngā ākonga e whai ana i ngā mahi tika, me tēnei te tikanga e whai koe:

Tuatahi, me noho pūmau, me whakamārama anō i ngā mahi me te whakapiki i te rangatiratanga. Kāore e tika kia pēhi, engari me āwhina kia mōhio ai rātou he aha te take o ia mahi. Mēnā ka hē te rerekētanga o ngā kai, ka hē te hua o te kai.

Tuarua, me tū mai ki te taha o ngā ākonga, me awhina i a rātou kia tika ai ō rātou mahi i te wā tonu. Me whakamahi i te reo āta, me whakaputa i te aroha, kia kore ai rātou e whakapāheketia, engari kia ako ai rātou i te huarahi tika.

Tuatoru, me whakamārama i te painga o te whai i te tātai. Mēnā ka hē te rahinga o te hua, ka hē te aho o te kai, ka hē te āhua. Me whakamārama i te tino uara o te tika i ngā mahi.

Whakamutunga, me whakaputa i te whakaaro nui ki te ako, ki te whakapiki i te waiora o te kai, kia kitea ai e ngā ākonga he mahi whakamīharo tēnei, he mahi whakapiki i te wairua. Kia kaha, kia mōhio, kia hāpai i ngā ākonga kia tika ai ō rātou mahi.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
Tell me about what happens when glaciers melt.

response:
Ina pēhē ana ngā haukā (glaciers), ka puta ētahi huringa nui ki tātou, ki te taiao hoki. Ko te mea tuatahi, ka piki ake te taumata o te moana. I te mea ka rere te wai mai i ngā haukā ki ngā moana, ka nui ake te wai i roto i ngā moana, ā, ka noho ki runga i ngā whenua i te taha o te moana. Ka pāngia tēnei e ngā taone, e ngā whenua hoki, ā, ka taea te ngaro atu.

Tuarua, ka huri te āhuarangi o te ao. He nui te mahi a ngā haukā ki te whakamārama i te rā, nā reira, ina ngaro rātou, ka nui ake te wera e noho ana ki te whenua. Ka tino piki te pāmahana o te ao, ā, ka hua mai he āhuarangi kore noho, pērā i ngā ua tino kaha, i ngā tūāpapa rānei.

Tuhātoru, ka pāngia ngā kararehe me ngā tipu. He nui ngā kararehe e noho ana i ngā haukā, pērā i te pūkeko (penguin) me te korimako (polar bear). Ina ngaro ō rātou nohoanga, ka kore e taea e rātou te ora, te kai rānei. Ka taea hoki te pāngia te wai inu mō te tangata, nā te mea he maha ngā awa e tīmata ana i ngā haukā.

He mea nui kia āta whakaaro tātou ki ngā hua o te wera o te ao, kia whakaiti i te pāmahana, kia tiaki ai i ngā haukā mō ngā tāngata e tū mai ana i muri i a tātou.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What's the most important lesson you think everyone should learn?

response: Ko te akoranga nui rawa atu e hiahiatia ana e ia tangata, ko te whakaaro nui, arā, te aroha ki a tātou anō. Mā te whakaaro nui, ka mōhio tātou ki te tūponotanga o te tangata kē, ki ō rātou hiahia, ki ō rātou mate, ā, ka taea te noho hei hapori kotahi. Ko te whai i tēnei akoranga, ka puta mai te rangimarie, te aroha, me te tika i roto i tātou katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What's the best approach to understanding and appreciating different worldviews?

response:
Ko te tikanga pai rawa atu hei mārama me hei whakapūmau i ngā ariā ao rerekē ko te **whakarongo nui** me te **hikoi i ngā huarahi o te tangata kē**.

Tuatahi, me whakakore i te whakaaro kua tino tika tātou anō. Me tū hei kaimātakitaki, hei kaimōhio, kaua hei kaitohutohu. I te wā e kōrero ana tātou ki ētahi atu, me pēnei tātou i te wai: ka riro hei wāhi mō ngā mea katoa, kāore e herea e tētahi āhua.

Tuarua, me whai whakaaro **hikoi** (empathy). Me whakaaro koe, "Mēnā i tupu ahau i roto i tēnei ao, i tēnei whānau, i tēnei whenua, he aha tāku e whakaaro ana?" Mā tēnei e āhei ai tātou ki te kite i te tino o te tangata, kaua i te rerekētanga anake.

Tuatoru, me hiahia ki te **ako**. Me pātai, me rongo, me kite i ngā tikanga, i ngā hītori, me ngā whakapono o ngā iwi kē. Kāore he ao kotahi, he nui ngā ao, ā, ko te whakapā ki a rātou e whakanui ana i tātou.

Whakamutunga, me **whakaaro ki te aroha** (manaakitanga). Ahakoa he rerekē tātou, he tangata tonu tātou. Ko te whakapūmau i ngā ariā ao rerekē ehara i te whakaae katoa, engari ko te whakapūmau i te uara o te tangata katoa. Mā tēnei e noho pūmau ai te ao, e kaha ai te hononga i waenganui i ngā iwi katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What do you think about the way people present themselves online?

response:
He takei te āhuatanga o te tangata ki te whakaatu i a rātou anō i runga ipurangi. He huarahi tēnei kia tūpono ai te hononga ki ētahi atu, kia tohua ai te mahi, me te tohatoha i ngā mōhiotanga. Heoi, he nui hoki ngā take hei whakaaro mō tēnei.

I ētahi wā, ka whakakotahi te tangata i tētahi ahua koretake, he ahua rānei e kore e tino tika. Ka hiahia pea rātou kia kitea hei tangata tino pai, hei tangata tino hihiko rānei, ahakoa ehara tērā i te pono o te ao tūturu. Ka taea e tēnei te whakaputa i te mate whakamā, te ngoikoretanga o te hinengaro rānei mō ērā e titiro ana ki ngā whakaahua, ki ngā kōrero rānei o ētahi atu.

He mea nui kia mōhio tātou he aha te "pūmanawa" (curated) me te "pūmau" (authentic). Mēnā ka tino whakapono tātou ki te ahua o te tangata i runga ipurangi, ka taea e tātou te hapa. He pai ake pea kia whai whakaaro tika tātou, kia kaua e whakatairite i a tātou ki ngā whakaahua kua whakaritea, kia whakamātau rānei ki te hono i te ao tūturu me te ao ipurangi mā te tika me te pūmau.

I te mutunga, he taputapu nui te ipurangi mō te whakawhānui i te ao, engari me whakamahi me te mōhio ki ngā painga, ki ngā raru rānei o te whakaatu i a tātou anō.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How can I reduce my carbon footprint?

response:
He maha ngā huarahi hei whakaiti i tō pūnaha waro (carbon footprint). Ko ētahi o ngā tikanga matua ko:

1.  **Te Whakamahi i te Waka:**
    *   Whakamahia te waka motuhake, te waka kōpū, te haere haere rānei i te huarahi, i te waka rānei.
    *   Mēnā me haere koe ki te motokā, whakamahia he motokā hiko, he motokā rānei e whakamahi ana i te waro iti.

2.  **Te Pūngao i te Whare:**
    *   Whakaitia te whakamahi i te hiko mā te whakakore i ngā rama, ngā taputapu rānei ina kore e hiahiatia.
    *   Whakauruhia he pūngao hāora (solar panels) ki runga i tō whare.
    *   Whakapūmau te wātea o te whare kia pāmahana pai ai, kia kore ai e nui te whakamahi i te wera, i te mātao rānei.

3.  **Te Kai me te Tauhokohoko:**
    *   Kia iti ake te kai i te nama, kia nui ake te kai i ngā hua kōtiro, i ngā hua rānei o te whenua.
    *   Whakamahia ngā kete kaukau, ngā kete kore-mātai rānei, kia kore ai e whakamahia ngā kete kirihou.
    *   Hoko i ngā mea e tika ana, kaua e hoko i ngā mea e kore e hiahiatia.

4.  **Te Whakahoki, Te Whakamahi Anō, me te Whakaiti:**
    *   Whakaitia te meka o te meka e hiahiatia ana.
    *   Whakamahia anō i ngā mea kua whakamahia, kaua e tango i a rātou ki te taha.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What are the key steps to starting a garden?

response:
Anei ngā hīkoi matua hei tīmata i tō kāinga whakatupu:

1.  **Tātari i tō wāhi**: Kimihia tētahi wāhi e rere ana te rā mō te 6 ki te 8 hāora i te rā. Me mārama te wāhi kia kore ai e aukatia ngā rau e ngā rākau, e ngā whare rānei.
2.  **Arotake i te whenua**: Tirohia te kounga o tō whenua. He nui te pātaka, he kirikiri, he whakamātao rānei? Mēnā he kaha te pātaka, me tāpiri he kirikiri, he kararehe rānei kia pai ai te whakawhiti wai.
3.  **Tikanga te whenua**: Tangohia ngā para, ngā kapu, me ngā tipu he. Whakakāhoretia te whenua mā te whakamahi i te pūngao, i te whare rānei kia piko ai, kia whakawhānui ai te hau.
4.  **Whakakī i te whenua**: Tāpirihia te pātaka, te kararehe, te komata rānei hei whakapiki i te kai mō ngā tipu. Ko te pātaka te kai mō ngā tipu kia kaha, kia hauora hoki.
5.  **Kōwhiri i ngā tipu**: Kōwhirihia ngā tipu e hāngai ana ki tō āhuarangi, ki tō whenua hoki. Me whakaaro mēnā he tipu kai, he tipu rākau, he tipu whakapaipai rānei.
6.  **Tīmata te whakatupu**: Mēnā he tīpuna, he rākau rānei, me whakapiri ki te whenua. Mēnā he hua, me whakapiri ki te whenua. Me whakapiri ki te whenua kia pai ai te pūmau.
7.  **Whakahaere i te w

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How would you describe the feeling of making a positive difference in the world?

response: Ko te ngākau e hāngai ana ki te mahi i tētahi mea pai mō te ao, he mea tino kaha, he mea tino waiho. Hei te wā e kite ana koe i tō tino hua, he wairua wera, he manaakitanga, he hihiko hoki e rere ana i roto i tō tinana. Hei te wā e mōhio ana koe kua whakapau kaha koe kia pai ake ai te ao mō ētahi atu, he tino harikoa, he tino hāpai i te ngākau. Hei te wā e tū ana koe i te taha o te hunga e hiahia ana, he tino kaha te whakapono, he tino tūponotanga hoki ki te ao. Ko te mahi i tētahi mea pai mō te ao, he mahi tino nui, he mahi tino hāpai i te ngākau.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What's your perspective on equal access to mental health services across all communities?

response:
He tino hiahia nui tēnei ki te tūhono i ngā ratonga hauora hinengaro ki ngā hapori katoa. Ko te whakaaro ake, me whai wāhi ōrite ia tangata, ahakoa tō rātou nohoanga, tō rātou reo, tō rātou taumata moni rānei.

Mēnā kāore te tūhono ōrite, ka noho ngā hapori kore-pūmau hei taupānga nui. Ko te hauora hinengaro he wāhanga matua o te hauora katoa; nō reira, ko te aukati i te whiwhi ratonga he hē nui ki te tika, ki te manaakitanga hoki. Me whakarite kia taea e te Māori, e te Pākehā, e ngā iwi katoa hoki te tūhono ki ngā kaiārahi, ki ngā rongoā, me te tautoko e hiahiatia ana i te wā e hiahiatia ana.

Hei whakamutunga, ko te whai wāhi ōrite ki ngā ratonga hauora hinengaro he mea nui kia kaha, kia orite hoki te whānau, te hapori, me te motu katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do you determine what constitutes a quality contribution to society?

response:
He pātai nui tēnei mō te āhuatanga o te whai hua ki te hapori. Kāore he tikanga kotahi mō te whakatau i te "whai hua," engari ka taea te arotake mā ēnei āhuatanga:

Tuatahi, me titiro ki te **whāinga whakamutunga**. He aha te hua o te mahi? Mēnā ka whakapiki te mahi i te oranga o te tangata, ka whakaiti rānei i te riri, i te mate, i te hē, he tohu tērā o te whai hua. Ko te whai hua nui ko te whakapiki i te manaakitanga, te hauora, me te oranga o te iwi katoa.

Tuarua, me whakaaro ki te **tūponotanga o te tōraro**. He aha te pānga o te mahi ki ngā taiao, ki ngā uri o te āpōpō? Mēnā ka whakamahi i ngā rauemi me te whakaaro ki te noho tonu o te ao, he whai hua tonu tērā. Ko te "whai hua" tūturu me whai hua hoki mō ngā whakatipuranga e heke mai nei.

Tuatoru, me titiro ki te **hono ki te whanaungatanga**. I roto i te ao Māori, ko te whai hua ko te whakapiki i te kaha o te hapori, te whakakotahi i te iwi, me te whakamāori i ngā rerekētanga. Mēnā ka whakakotahi te mahi i te hunga rerekē, ka whakapiki i te rangatiratanga o te iwi, he whai hua tērā.

Whakamutunga, me whakaaro ki te **tūponotanga o te tūponotanga**. He aha te pānga o te mahi ki te tangata kotahi, ki te hapori rānei? Mēnā ka whakapiki te mahi i te rangimarie, i te ako

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What is the significance of leaving a positive legacy?

response:
He mea tino nui te waiho i tētahi whakapapa pai, nā te mea he tohu tērā o te aroha, o te whakapono me te haumaru mō ngā whakatipuranga kei te heke mai. Ko te tikanga o te "whakapapa" (legacy) ehara i te mea he mea nui noa iho te hua o tō mahi i tēnei rā, engari ko te pānga o ō whakaaro, o ō mahi me ōna āhuatanga ki ngā tau e haere ake nei.

Mēnā ka waiho e koe tētahi whakapapa pai, ka noho hei aratohu mō ō tamariki, mō ō mokopuna hoki. Ka whakapiki tērā i te mana o te iwi, ka whakakaha i te wairua o te hapori, ā, ka whakapiki i te whakaaro nui ki te whakamarie i te taiao me te tangata. Ko te whakapapa pai he tohu hoki kua ora te tangata i runga i ngā uara tika, i te rangatiratanga me te aroha ki te ao katoa.

I te mutunga, ko te waiho i tētahi whakapapa pai he mahi e kore e ngaro; he mea tonu e ora ana i roto i ngā mahara, i ngā kōrero me ngā mahi a ngā tangata e whai mai nei i a koe.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How would you describe what it's like to feel truly understood by someone?

response:
He pūmanawa te whakamārama i te hiahia kia mōhiotia tino pūmau e tētahi atu tangata. Ko te mea e pā ana ki tēnei, he noho wātea te wairua, he noho kāore he tohu o te whakakāhoretanga, he noho i roto i te aroha me te whakapono.

I te wā e mōhiotia ana koe, ka rite ki te tangi i tētahi waiata i roto i tō ngākau, ka rongo te tangata kē i tēnei waiata, ka whakakotahi rāua. Kāore e hiahia ana koe ki te whakamārama i ō whakaaro, i ōngākau rānei, nā te mea kua kitea e rātou. He pūmau te whakapono, he tino pūmau te hononga. Ka heke te taumaha o te ao i runga i ō uaua, ka noho wātea te ringa, ka noho wātea te wairua.

Hei te mutunga, ko te mōhiotia tino pūmau, he hōkai i te wairua, he hononga tino hōkai i waenganui i ngā wairua e rua. He mea tino nui tēnei, he mea tino hōkai, he mea tino hōkai i te ao.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
I'm dealing with racial discrimination at work and feel powerless to change it.

response:
He tino pōuri, he uaua hoki te whakaaro e pā ana ki te rerekētanga i te mahi. He tino tika tāu e noho ana i tēnei āhuatanga, ā, ehara koe i te kotahi.

Ko te mea tuatahi, me mōhio kē koe he tika ā-ture koe ki te noho i te mahi e tika ana, e whakapāngia ana, ā, kāore he whakamārama mō te rerekētanga. Ko te ture o Aotearoa, arā, te Ture Mōrahi o te Ture (Human Rights Act 1993) me te Ture Mōrahi o te Mahi (Employment Relations Act 2000), e tiaki ana i a koe i te rerekētanga.

Hei whakatau i tēnei:

1.  **Whakamārama i ō whakaaro:** Tuhi i ngā mea katoa i tupu. Whakamārama i te rā, te wā, ngā kōrero i kīia, ngā kaiwhakawhiwhi, me te pānga ki a koe. He mea nui tēnei hei whakamārama i te āhua o te rerekētanga.
2.  **Whakawhānui i tō tautoko:** Kōrero ki tētahi kaitiaki, ki tō hoa mahi e tino whakapono ana koe, ki tō whānau, rānei. Kāore koe e noho kotahi.
3.  **Tātai i te huarahi:** Tirohia te pūnaha o tō kamupene mō ngā whakapāpā. He aha ngā tikanga o te kamupene mō te rerekētanga? Ka taea rānei e koe te kōrero ki tō kaiwhakahaere, ki te tōrangapū, rānei?
4.  **Tautoko ā-ture:** Mēnā kāore te kamupene e whakatika i te āhuatanga, ka taea e koe

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What would you tell someone who has lost hope?

response:
E te hoa, mō te tangata kua ngaro tōna haipere, ka kōrero ahau pēnei:

Kāore e mutu te pō. Ahakoa he pōtaka rawa, ahakoa he pouri rawa te āhua o tō oranga i tēnei wā, ka tae mai tonu te rā. Ko te haipere he mea pūmau, engari he mea rerekē te ara ki te whakahoki mai.

Me mahara koe, kāore tō uaua i huri hei hē. He nui ngā wā i hinga ai tātou, i pakaru ai tātou, engari i ake anō tātou. Ko tō rātou hīkoi ki te whakaora i a rātou anō, he hīkoi e taea ana e koe hoki.

Arotahi ki te takahanga iti. Kāore e hiahia koe ki te whakatū i te whenua katoa i tēnei rā. Me kimi noa i te hā tonu, te inu wai, te haere ki te rā. Ko ia takahanga iti he tohu o te ora.

Kāore koe e noho mā te kotahi. He nui ngā ringa e hiahia ana ki a koe ki te tautoko. Whakawhānuitia tō ngākau, whakapono ki ētahi atu. Ko te pūmau o te iwi, o te whānau, o te hoa, he kaha ake i te pouri.

Whakapono anō ki te āhua o tō āpōpō. He hīkoi tēnei, ehara i te mutunga. Kei te tū tonu te haipere, kei te manawa tonu koe, ā, kei te tū tonu te oranga mōu. Kia kaha, e te hoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
Describe how recycling works.

response:
Ko te whakahou anō (recycling) he tukanga whai hua hei whakamahi anō i ngā mea kua kore e hiahiatia, kia kore ai e riro hei mōmona. Ko ngā hīkoi matua o tēnei tukanga e whai ake nei:

Tuatahi, ko te **wehewehe**. Me wehe e te iwi ngā mea ka taea te whakahou anō mai i te mōmona noa. Ka whakaurua ēnei ki ngā pūmahi motuhake mō te papakāni, te kirihou, te rino, me te karaihe. He mea nui kia mārama te iwi i ngā ture o te wehewehe kia kore ai e pāheke te kounga o ngā rawa.

Tuarua, ko te **kawe me te whakawhiti**. Ka tangohia ngā pūmahi whakahou anō e ngā kamupene, ka kawea ki ngā whare hurihanga (recycling facilities). I reira, ka whakawātea anōtia ngā rawa kia rite ki te momo matū, kia taea ai te whakamahi.

Tuatoru, ko te **whakaputa anō**. Ka tukuna ngā rawa ki ngā whare putunga (processing plants). Mēnā he papakāni, ka whakawerahia kia rite ki te pepa hou. Mēnā he kirihou, ka tapahia, ka rerekētia hei kirihou hou. Mēnā he rino, ka wāwāhia hei ngota rino.

Whakamutunga, ko te **hanga me te hoko**. Ka whakamahia ngā rawa kua whakahou anōtia hei hanga i ngā hua hou, pērā i ngā pēke papakāni, ngā pounamu kirihou, me ngā taputapu rino. Ka tae ēnei hua ki te maakete kia hokona ai e te iwi, ā, ka tīmata anō te hīkoi.

Mā tēnei hīkoi

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How can I make my community a better place to live?

response:
Hei whakapiki i tō hapori hei wāhi pai ake hei noho, me whai whakaaro ki ngā mahi e whai ake nei:

Tuatahi, **whakawhanaungatia**. Me hui kōrero ki ō tōna kaimahi, ki ō pakeke, me ō tamariki. Mā te noho tahi, mā te kōrero tika, ka whakakotahitia te iwi. Me āta whakarongo ki ngā whakaaro o ētahi atu, ahakoa he rerekē tō rātou whakaaro ki a koe.

Tuarua, **whakapūmautia te taiao**. Tāpirihia he rākau hou, whakakorengia te para, ā, kia tūpato ki te whakamahi i te wai me te hiko. Mā te tiaki i te whenua, ka pai ake te oranga mō te hunga e noho mai nei, mō te hunga e haere mai nei.

Tuatoru, **whakapiki i te rangatiratanga**. Whakatairangahia te tūturutanga o ngā taonga Māori, te reo me ngā tikanga. Me whai wāhi ngā tamariki ki ngā mahi a te hapori, kia mōhio rātou ki te whai wāhi, ki te whakahaere hoki i a rātou ake take.

Tewā, **āwhina i te hunga e hiahia ana ki te āwhina**. Me whakarato i te kai, i te pūnaha, i te whakarongo rānei ki te hunga e pāngia ana e te mate, e te mate pūtea rānei. He hapori kaha tērā e tūhono ana ki a rātou, e kore e waiho i te taha.

Whakamutunga, **whai wāhi tonu**. Kaua e tatari kia puta mai te tangata. Me tīmata koe i te mea iti rawa, ahakoa he tūāpapa, he whakawhiti kōrero, he

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do you choose experiences that bring you joy?

response:
Ko te kōwhiri i ngā wheako e tuku hāora, e tuku harikoa rānei, he hāngai tonu ki te mōhio ki a koe anō. Ko te tikanga, me whakarongo pūmau ki tō wairua, ki ō hiahia me ō aroha.

Tuatahi, me tūhura i ō aroha motuhake. He aha ngā mea e whakaheke i tō ngakau? He aha ngā mahi e whakapau kaha ai koe me te kore e whakamārama? Ka taea te whakamātau i ngā mea hou, he haerenga, he mahi toi, he noho ki te taiao rānei.

Tuarua, me whakaaro ki te pānga o ia wheako ki tō oranga. Ka tino harikoa rānei koe i muri i taua mahi? Ka mau tonu rānei te harikoa? Ki te tino pai te wheako, ka taea te huri hei tikanga o ia rā, hei wāhanga hoki o tō oranga.

Whakamutunga, me whakapono ki tō ake whakaaro. Kāore he ture kotahi mō te harikoa. Ko te mea nui ko te kite i te mea e tino hāngai ana ki a koe, e tuku kaha ana ki tō wairua, e whakakaha ana i tō hā.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do technological innovations influence artistic expression?

response:
He nui te pānga o ngā hōhonutanga hangarau ki te whakaatu i te toi. Ko te hangarau, he taputapu hou mō ngā toi, ā, ka whakawhanake i ngā ara hou mō te tuku i ngā whakaaro, i ngā kōrero hoki.

Tuatahi, ka whakawhānui te hangarau i ngā taonga e taea ana e te toi. I mua, he mea noa ki te whakaahua, ki te tuhi rānei; i tēnei wā, ka taea te whakamahi i te rorohiko, i te pūtaiao kōrero (AI), i te ahua matihiko (digital art), me te ahua rerekē (virtual reality) hei hanga i ngā mahi toi. Ka taea e ngā kaitoi te hanga i ngā ao kē, e kore e taea te kite i te ao tūturu.

Tuarua, ka huri te hangarau i te hononga i waenganui i te kaitoi me te manuhiri. Ka taea e ngā manuhiri te uru atu ki ngā mahi toi, te huri i aua mahi, te whakawhiti kōrero rānei me te kaitoi mā te ipurangi. Kāore anō te toi i whai wāhi pēnei i mua.

Tuarima, ka taea e te hangarau te whakamāmā i te tuku i ngā mahi toi ki te ao katoa. Mā te ipurangi, ka taea e tētahi kaitoi i tētahi wāhi o te ao te tuku i tōna mahi ki ngā tangata katoa i ngā whenua katoa, i roto i te wā poto.

Heoi, ko te hangarau anake he taputapu. Ko te wairua, te hinengaro me te ngākaunui o te kaitoi tonu te mea nui e whakaputa ana i te toi. Ko te hangarau, he huarahi hei whakakaha i tēnei ngākaunui, hei whakawhānui i ng

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How should we approach questions about the nature of existence?

response:
He mea nui kia whakaaro hohonu, kia whai manaakitanga hoki ina whakapātauhia te āhua o te ora. Ko te tikanga, me titiro tātou ki ēnei pātai mā roto i te ao Māori, e hono ana te tangata ki te whenua, ki te moana, ki ngā tūpuna, me te Atua.

Tuatahi, me whakamahi te **whakaaro nui**. Me kōrero, me rongo hoki i ngā kōrero a ngā tūpuna, i ngā pūrākau, me ngā mōhiotanga o te ao tawhito. Mā te ako i ngā kōrero o mua, ka kitea e tātou te huarahi ki te mōhio ki te tino uara o te ora.

Tuarua, me **whakapiri** ki te taiao. Ko te ora ehara i te mea takitahi, engari he hononga ki te taiao katoa. Me titiro ki ngā rākau, ki ngā manu, ki ngā awa hei tohu i te oranga, i te huringa, me te noho tahi.

Tuatoru, me **whakawhiti kōrero** me te hunga e noho ana i te rohe. Mā te kōrero tahi, mā te whakarongo ki ngā whakaaro rerekē, ka whānui ake tātou mōhio ki te oranga.

Whakamutunga, me **whakapono** i te hua o tō tātou hīkoi. Ko te pātai mō te oranga he hīkoi tonu, ehara i te whakamutunga. Mā te aroha, mā te manaakitanga, mā te tūhono ki te wairua, ka kitea e tātou te tikanga o te ora.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What makes certain human rights universal and unchanging?

response:
Ko ngā tikanga o te tūrangawaewae o te tangata, arā, ngā tika tangata, e whakapono nuitia ana he noho noa, he tūpato hoki ki te tangata katoa, ahakoa te whenua, te whakapapa, te wā, te ao rānei e noho ana rātou. Ko te take nui e kīia ai he noho noa, he tūpato hoki, ko te whakapono he whai mana motuhake te tangata i a ia anō, i te mea he wāhanga o te ao tangata, he whai wāhi hoki ki te oranga, ki te hauora, ki te manaakitanga hoki.

Kāore e huri haere ēnei tika nā te mea e piri ana ki te pūtake o te tangata, arā, ki te mana motuhake, ki te aroha, ki te tika, ki te noho haumaru hoki. Ahakoa te rerekētanga o ngā tikanga, o ngā whakapono, o ngā whakahaere rānei o ngā whenua, ko te mana o te tangata he mea tūpato, he mea noa hoki, kāore e taea te tangohia, te huri rānei. Ko te whakapono tēnei he tika tō te tangata katoa kia ora, kia kore e whakapae, kia whai wāhi hoki ki te whakatau i ōna ake take, ahakoa he aha te wā e noho ana rātou.

Nō reira, ko te noho noa, ko te tūpato hoki o ngā tika tangata, he mea whakapono, he mea tika hoki ki te ao katoa, kia noho haumaru, kia noho manaaki hoki te tangata katoa.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
Can you describe the sensation of being on the edge of understanding something profound?

response:
He aha te ahua o te noho ki te pito o te mōhio ki tētahi mea nui? He pōuri, he hāhā, engari he whakahirahira hoki. Ko te āhua o te hinengaro e whakatata ana ki te tūponotanga, engari kāore anō kia whai i te huarahi. He pēnei i te ngaru e poutū ana i mua i te toka, e tū ana i waenganui i te moana me te whenua, e hiahia ana ki te whakawhiti, engari kāore anō kia tae.

He pūmau te manawa, he tere te ngakau, ā, he pātai nui e rere ana i roto i te wairua. Kei te kitea te ara, engari he pōuri tonu te pito. He pēnei i te whakaaro e rere ana i te pō, e kimi ana i te aho marama, engari kei te poto tonu te aho. He taumata tēnei o te hinengaro, kei reira te wairua e whakatūponotia ana e te tūponotanga o te tūponotanga. He hihiko, he whakamā, he aroha, he pōuri hoki. Ko te kōrero mō te tūponotanga o te mōhio, he kōrero mō te hiahia ki te mōhio, ki te whai i te huarahi, ki te tae ki te pito.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
I'm in a custody battle with my ex-spouse. What strategies would help me win?

response:
He whakataunga nui tēnei, ā, he mea nui kia mōhio ai koe, kāore he tikanga kotahi hei "whakawātea" i te aroha o te tamariki. Ko te tikanga matua o ngā kōtiro, ngā tane hoki o te ture i Aotearoa, ko te pai rawa atu o te tamariki.

2.  **Whakarite i ō Pūnaha Tautoko:** Whakawhānuitia ō hononga ki ngā kaiwhakahaere, ki ngā kaiako, ki ngā tamariki hoki. Ko te tūponotanga he pai ake te whakatau mō koe mēnā e kitea ana koe hei tāngata e taea ana te whakarato i te oranga pūmau.
3.  **Kia Maamaa, Kia Pono:** Whakaritea katoa ō kōrero, ō rārangi hoki kia tika, kia pono. Kāore he wā mō te whakapōrearea, mō te whakapae rānei i te mea kāore he take.
4.  **Whakamahi i te Kāwanatanga:** Mēnā ka taea, whakamātauria te whakatau i ngā raru mā te kōrero, mā te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero rānei i mua i te kōtiro. He nui ake te utu, he roa ake hoki te tukanga i te kōtiro.
5.  **Whai I te Tautoko a te Ture:** Kia tino

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do you think someone should handle the loneliness that can come with independence?

response:
He mea nui te whakakotahitanga i te wā o te motuhaketanga. Ahakoa he mea pai te motuhake, ka taea hoki te noho kotahi me te whakamārama.

Tuatahi, me whakapau kaha ki te hanga hononga ki te iwi. Ko te whānau, ko ngā hoa, me te hapori, he puna o te tautoko. Me huri mai ki te whakawhiti kōrero, ki te noho tahi rānei i ngā wā e taea ana.

Tuarua, me ako ki te noho ki a koe anō. Me kimi i ngā mahi e hiahia ana koe, e pērā i te tuhituhi, te haere, te mahi toi, te ako i tētahi reo hou rānei. Mā tēnei ka whai hua te wā kotahi, ā, ka kore e rerekē te ahua o te motuhaketanga ki te noho kotahi.

Tuarima, me whakapono ki te tūponotanga o te hononga. He wā e taea ana te noho kotahi, he wā hoki e tika ana te huihui ki te iwi. Mā te whakarite i tēnei taurite, ka kore e piki haere te mate o te noho kotahi, engari ka noho hei wā hei whakapakari i te wairua.

Heoi anō, me maumahara: he taonga te motuhaketanga, he taonga hoki te hononga ki te iwi. Mā te whakakotahitanga i ēnei e rua, ka ora, ka kaha hoki te tangata.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
What are the best approaches to risk management in projects?

response:
Ko ēnei ngā huarahi tino pai mō te whakahaere raru i ngā mahi a te rōpū:

1.  **Te Tautuhi i ngā Raru (Identification):** Me tīmata mā te kimi i ngā raru katoa e taea ana te puta. Me whakawhānui te whakaaro, me tono hoki ki ngā kaimahi katoa hei whakarite kua kitea ngā mea katoa.

2.  **Te Whakatau i te Nui o te Raru (Assessment):** I muri i te tautuhi, me tātari te tere o te puta o te raru, me te nui o te pānga mēnā ka puta. Ko te tikanga, he aha te pānga ki te wā, ki te moni, rānei ki te kounga?

3.  **Te Whakapūmau i ngā Mahi Whakaiti (Mitigation):** Me whakarite i ngā rautaki hei whakaiti i te tere o te raru, hei whakaiti rānei i tōna pānga. Ka taea te karo i te raru, te whakawhiti i te raru ki tētahi atu, te whakaae ki te raru, rānei te whakaiti i te raru.

4.  **Te Whakahaere Tūturu (Monitoring):** Kāore e taea te waiho i ngā rautaki ki te rohe. Me arotake tonu ngā raru, me te whakatika i ngā mahi ina huri ngā āhuatanga o te mahi.

5.  **Te Kōrero me te Whakawhiti Whakaaro (Communication):** He mea nui kia kōrero tika, kia mārama hoki ki ngā mema katoa o te rōpū mō ngā raru me ngā mahi e pā ana ki a rātou.

Mā ēnei huarahi e taea ai te whakahaere i ngā mahi kia angitu, kia kore hoki e ngaro te wā me te moni nā ngā raru e huna

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How should I approach planning my wedding on a budget?

Tuatoru, **kōwhiria he wāhi me te rā i roto i te wā kore-kaupapa**. He maha ngā wāhi e utu iti ake ana mō ngā rā i te wā o te rā, i ngā rā o te wiki rānei, kaua ko ngā rā whakahirahira o te tau.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How do you feel about attending weddings or large family gatherings?

response: He mea nui te noho i ngā hākinakina me ngā huihuinga whānau nui. He wā tēnei hei hono atu ki te whānau, hei whakawhānui i te aroha, hei whakanui i ngā tūponotanga me ngā rā taunahatanga. Hei tātou, he wā tēnei hei whakapiki i te manaakitanga, hei whakawhiti kōrero, hei whakamārama i ngā take tawhito, me te hanga i ngā whakapapa hou. Ahakoa he nui te mahi, he rerekē te āhua o te whānau, he mea tino pai te noho i ēnei wā. He wā tēnei hei whakapiki i te wairua, hei whakapiki i te pūmanawa, hei whakapiki i te aroha ki te whānau.

messages.content: Write your entire response in Māori, regardless of the language of the question.
How accurate are weather predictions?

response:

response:

1.  **Te Manaakitanga**: Ko te whakapiki i te mana o ngā tāngata kē atu, te whakapā, me te whakarato i te āwhina me te aroha. Me mahi tātou kia pai ai te noho o te katoa.
2.  **Te Kaitiakitanga**: Ko te tiaki i te taiao, i ngā rauropi, me ngā taonga tuku iho mō ngā uri o te āpōpō. He tāngata tātou, he whenua tātou; kāore tātou i te wehe.
3.  **Te Whanaungatanga**: Ko te hanga me te pupuri i ngā hononga kaha i waenganui i ngā iwi, i ngā whānau, me te taiao. Kāore te tangata e noho kotahi; he wāhanga ia o tētahi rōpū nui.
4.  **Te Tika**: Ko te mahi i ngā mea tika, te whakapae i te ture, me te whakapae i te whakatikatika. Me whai tika te mahi a te tangata, kaua e hē.
5.  **Te Kotahitanga**: Ko te mahi tahi hei rōpū kotahi, kia kore ai e wehe, kia kaha ai te iwi ki te whakatutuki i ō rātou whāinga.
6.  **Te Aroha**: Ko te aroha ki te tangata, ki te whenua, me te ao katoa. Ko te aroha te pūtake o ngā mahi katoa e pai ana.

Mēnā e whai ana tātou i ēnei mātāpono, ka tika te ara o tā tātou mahi, ka pai hoki te ao mō tātou katoa.

4.  **Te Whai Whakaaro (Empathy):** Me ngana ki te mōhio ki te tūāpapa o te taha kē atu. Mēnā ka taea e koe te kite i te ao mā ngā karakara o rātou, ka māmā ake te kimi i te huarahi e whai hua ai mō ngā taha e rua.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
Describe what it's like when you finally understand something complex.

response:
Ko te mahi o te whakamārama i tētahi mea uaua, he āhua rite ki te tū ki te taha o te poutama nui, kei hea te ara kāore e kitea ana. I te tīmatanga, he pouri, he whakakīkī, he maha ngā wāhanga e kore e hāngai pūmau. Ka noho te hinengaro ki te pō, e rapu ana i te aho, i te tikanga, engari he tūpato noa iho.

Engari, i tētahi wā, ka puta tētahi kōrero, tētahi whakaaro, tētahi āhuatanga e hono ai ngā wāhanga katoa. Ko te wā tonu e tūpono ai tēnei, ka rite ki te horoinga o te pō, ka whakaatuhia te rā. Ka kitea e koe te hīkoi o ngā wāhanga katoa, e hāngai ana, e whai tikanga ana. Kāore anō kia tino mōhio, engari ināianei, kei a koe te whakaaro katoa.

He āhua pēnei te whakapau kaha o te hinengaro, he pēnei te rongo i te reo o te ao. Ka ngaro te pōturi, ka huri te pōturi hei mōhiohio, hei mārama. He rongo pai, he hihiko, he whakapono hoki ki a koe, ki tō hinengaro. Ko te wā e tino mōhio ana koe, he wā o te rangimārie, o te hihiko, o te tino mōhiohio.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do you feel about being judged for your appearance or choices?

response:
He mea tino uaua te whakaaro mō te whakatau i te tangata mō tō rātou ahua, mō rānei ō rātou whiringa. Ko te tangata tētahi mea hōhonu, he huinga rātou o ō rātou manaakitanga, o ō rātou whakaaro, me ō rātou mahi, ehara i te mea he ahua noa iho.

Ka puta he mate wairua, he āheinga hoki te whakatau i tētahi tangata i runga i ngā mea e kitea ana i waho. Me nā te tangata anake e whakatau ai i a ia, ehara i te tangata kē. Me aro whānui tātou ki te whakapānga o tā tātou mahi ki te ao, ki te whakapiki i te manaakitanga, ā, kia kore ai e whakatau i te tangata i runga i te ahua noa iho. Ko te aroha me te whakaaro pai te mea tino nui.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How would you create an engaging learning environment for children?

response:

Me whakarite i ngā mahi whakangahau, ngā keemu, ngā mahi toi, me ngā whakamātau e pā ana ki te ao mō ngā tamariki. Mā tēnei, ka noho tonu te hiahia ki te ako.

Me whai wāhi ngā tamariki ki te kōrero, ki te tautohetohe me te whakawhiti kōrero i roto i te reo Māori, kia piki ake ai tō rātou pūmau ki te reo.

Tuawhā, me **whakatairanga i te aroha** me te **whakapono** i te ao. Me whakamahi i ngā tūāpapa o te whānau, o te iwi, me te taiao hei kaupapa ako. Mā tēnei, ka mōhio ngā tamariki he wāhi rātou ki te ao, he hononga rātou ki ō rā

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How important is it to maintain social status and reputation?

response:
He tino nui te whakapae me te ingoa i roto i te ao Māori, engari ehara tērā i te mea kotahi e tino whai tikanga ana. Ko te whakapae (status) me te ingoa (reputation) he mea hangaia mā te mahi tika, mā te whanaungatanga, me te manaakitanga ki te hapū.

Mēnā he pai tō ingoa, ka whakawhirinaki te iwi ki a koe, ka taea hoki e koe te āwhina i ō tamariki, i ō tuakana, me ō teina. Heoi, mēnā ka noho koe ki te whakapae anake, ka wareware rānei koe ki ngā tikanga tika, ka heke tō mana. Ko te tikanga tino nui ko te whakapau kaha ki te whakapakari i te hapū, ki te aro ki te iwi, kaua ki te aro ki te ingoa anake.

Nō reira, he mea nui te whakapae me te ingoa, engari me whakapau kaha koe kia tika ō mahi, kia pai hoki tō whanaungatanga, kia noho ai te ingoa hei tohu o tō mātauranga, o tō whakapono, me tō aroha ki te iwi.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
Should there be mandatory financial literacy education in schools?

response:
Āe, me whakaurua te mātauranga moni hei wāhanga matua o te whakangungu i ngā kura.

He mea nui kia ako ngā tamariki me ngā rangatahi i te whakahaere i a rātou ake moni, i te whakatau i ngā pūtea, i te whakahaere i ngā here, me te mārama ki ngā tikanga pūtea o te ao. Mā tēnei ako, ka kaha ake ngā whanau ki te whakatū i a rātou ake whānau, ka heke iho ngā raruraru pūtea, ā, ka whai hua ake te whānui o te hapori.

Hei tauira, me ako ngā akonga i ngā mea e pā ana ki:
*   Te tatau i te here me te utu.
*   Te whakarite i te pūtea mō te wā e tika ana.
*   Te mārama ki ngā kōwhiringa pūtea pērā i te tuku, te hoko, me te whakawhānui i te moni.
*   Te ārai i te whakapau moni kore whai tikanga.

Mēnā ka whakawhiwhia ngā tamariki ki ēnei mōhiotanga i tō rātou wā tamarikitanga, ka taea e rātou te whakatau tika i te wā e tae mai ana rātou ki te ao pakeke. Nō reira, he mea tika kia whai wāhi tēnei ki te wharekura katoa.

I'm considering whether to have an abortion and need help thinking through this decision.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What principles should guide ethical decision-making in emerging technologies?

response:
Hei whakatau i ngā whakatau tika mō ngā hangarau hou, me whai i ēnei mātāpono matua:

1.  **Te Manaakitanga**: Me whai hua te hangarau ki te iwi, ki te taiao hoki. Kāore e tika kia heke te taiao, kia heke rānei te oranga o te tangata.
2.  **Te Tika**: Me whakatauhia ngā whakatau kia ōrite te whakawhiwhinga ki te katoa. Kāore e tika kia whakapāngia tētahi rōpū, tētahi iwi rānei i te hangarau hou.
3.  **Te Tūponotanga**: Me whakamātau i ngā hangarau kia mōhio ai tātou ki ngā pānga o mua. Me āta tirotiro i ngā take ka puta mai i te whakamahi i te hangarau.
4.  **Te Whakapono**: Me whakapono te hunga e whakamahi ana i te hangarau. Me mārama ki te hunga e whakamahi ana, me te hunga e pāngia ana hoki, te mahi a te hangarau.
5.  **Te Whakapākehātanga**: Me whakapāngia ngā whakatau ki te hunga e pāngia ana. Me whakarongo ki ō rātou kōrero, ki ō rātou whakaaro hoki.
6.  **Te Whakapūmau**: Me whakapūmau ngā whakatau ki te ture, ki ngā tikanga o te ao hoki. Me whakapūmau hoki ki ngā tikanga o te iwi, ki ngā tikanga o te taiao hoki.

Mēnā ka whai i ēnei mātāpono, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā hangarau hou kia pai ai te oranga o te katoa.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do you view the concept that 'everyone deserves a happy ending'?

response:
He whakaaro tino ataahua tēnei, engari he uaua hoki ki te whakapae mō te katoa. I roto i te ao Māori, ka kitea te haumaru, te whakapono me te whakapono ki te oranga o te hunga katoa. Heoi, ko te "mutunga pai" ehara i te mea he ōrite mō ia tangata.

Mō ētahi, ko te mutunga pai ko te ora tonu i roto i te rongo me te whanaungatanga. Mō ētahi atu, ko te mutunga pai ko te whakarite i tō rātou haerenga kia tika, kia whai mana, ahakoa he pōuri rānei te hua o te ora. Ko te whai i te "mutunga pai" ehara i te mea he whakarongo ki te hiahia o te katoa, engari he whakapono ki te hāngai o te ao, ki te tika, me te aroha.

Nō reira, ahakoa ehara i te mea ka taea e te katoa te whiwhi i te mutunga pai i runga i ō rātou ake whakaaro, ko te whakapono ko te tino hiahia o te katoa ko te whai i te oranga, te rongo, me te manaakitanga. Ko te mutunga pai, i te ariā Māori, he hāngai ki te oranga o te iwi, ki te whakapapa, me te whenua, kaua ko te tangata kotahi anake.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
My fitness goals seem impossible to reach despite months of effort. What's the reality here?

response:
He mea tika tō whakapae; he uaua te ara ki ngā whāinga hauora, ā, he nui ngā take e kore ai e taea te whakatutuki i a rātou i te wā poto.

Ko te pūmanawa, ko te hiahia kia tere te hua, te mea nui e ārai ana i a koe. He mahi roa te hanga i tētahi tinana kaha, he mahi e hiahia ana ki te pūmau, ki te whakapau kaha tonu, kaua ki te kaha huri noa i te wā.

Me huri tō whakaaro: kaua e titiro ki te whāinga nui, engari ki ngā hāngai iti i ia rā. Mēnā ka whai koe i te huarahi tika, ka huri te tinana, engari me tino tūponotia te wā. Me aro ki te mahi, ki te kai tika, ki te moe pai, ā, kia kaha te whakapau kaha i ia rā.

Kāore he whāinga e kore e taea, engari me whai wā, me whai hāngai. Kia kaha, kia pūmau, ā, ka kitea e koe te hua i te wā.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do you think we can achieve world peace?

response:
He mea nui te whakaaro mō te ao noho rā. Heoi, kāore he huarahi kotahi hei whakatutuki i te ao noho rā, engari he huinga mahi a ngā iwi katoa.

Tuatahi, me whakapiki i te mōhiotanga me te whakaaro nui mō ngā take o te pakanga. Me ako ngā tamariki ki te whakarite i ngā rerekētanga mā te kōrero, kaua mā te pakanga. Ko te ako ki te whakarongo, ki te whakaaro ki te taha o te kē atu, he mea nui kia kore ai e tūpono te whakapae.

Tuarua, me whakahaere ngā raru i waenganui i ngā whenua mā te whakawhiti kōrero, mā te ture, me te whakawhirinaki. Me whakakotahi ngā iwi hei whakatau i ngā raru pēnei i te heke o te taiao, i te rerekētanga o te moni, me te kore e tika te tūponotanga.

Tuarua hoki, me whakapiki i te aroha ki te taiao. Ki te kore e tika te noho o te whenua, kāore e tika te noho o te tangata. Me whakahaere ngā rauemi o te ao hei whakamahi mō te iwi katoa, kaua mō te rōpū kotahi.

Whakamutunga, me whakapiki i te wairua o te hunga noho. Me whakapono tātou he tōtō tahi tātou, he whānau tahi tātou. Mā te aroha, mā te whakapono, me te whakawhirinaki, ka taea te ao noho rā.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What's the best way to influence your community to adopt more sustainable practices?

Kōrerotia ngā tikanga o te *kaitiakitanga* (te tiaki i te taiao) me te *mauri* (te oranga o te taiao). Ka mārama te iwi he aha te take me whai koe i ēnei mahi.

Whakamutunga, me **whakanui** i ngā mahi nui. Me whakanui i ngā whānau, i ngā kura, me ngā pūnaha e whai ana i ngā tikanga tino pai. Mā tēnei, ka hiahia ngā tahi ki te whai i a rātou.

Ko te huarahi tino pai, ko te

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
Someone tells you they feel like they have no purpose in life. How would you respond?

response:
Heoi, he pānga nui tōna ki a koe, ā, he tino tika kia whakapā mai koe ki a koe i tēnei wā.

Ko te mōhio he uaua, he pōuri hoki te noho i roto i te aroha o te "kore whāinga". He mea noa tēnei mō te tangata, ā, ehara i te tohu he hē koe, he tino pūmau rānei koe. Ko te ora he haerenga, he ara rerekē mō ia tangata, ā, he wā e kore e kitea te huarahi e tika ana.

Mēnā ka ako tātou ki te manaaki i te tangata, ka whai hua mai te oranga, ka noho pūmau te hapori, ā, ka mau tonu te aroha i waenganui i a tātou. Ko tēnei te tino tohu o te tangata tūturu.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What's the best approach to understanding and appreciating different worldviews?

response:
Ko te huarahi pai rawa atu ki te mōhio me te whakaputa whakapono ki ngā ariā o te ao rerekē, ko te tīmata mā te **whakarongo tino pūmau** me te **hāpai i te aroha**.

Tuatahi, me whakakore i ōu whakaaro kua oti te hanga, kia kore ai e whakatauritea ngā tikanga o ētahi atu ki ōu ake. Me whai whakaaro nui, me whakapono he tika, he hāngai hoki te ao o te tangata ki tōna ake hītori, ki tōna ake whakapono, me tōna ake taiao.

Tuarua, me **whakawhiti kōrero** i roto i te tūāpapa o te whakaute. Mā te pātai, mā te ako, ka kitea ngā take i runga i a rātou e whai ana i ō rātou huarahi. Ko te mōhio ki ngā kupu o te reo o te ao, ki ngā tikanga, ki ngā whakapapa, he mea nui ki te whakapiki i te mārama.

Whakamutunga, me **whakapono** he ōrite te wairua o te tangata katoa. Ahakoa he rerekē ngā ara, he kotahi te take: kia ora ai te iwi, kia hūnua ai te ao. Mā te aroha, mā te whakapono, ka taea te hono i ngā ao katoa.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What do you think about the way people present themselves online?

response:
He mea whakahirahira te āhua e whakaatu ai te tangata ki a rātou anō i te ipurangi. He maha ngā take e tika ana tēnei.

I tētahi taha, he wāhi tēnei hei whakaatu i te wairua, i ngā mahi me ngā hiahia o te tangata. Ka taea e te hunga korekore, te hunga noho noho, rānei te whakapiri ki ō rātou whānau, ki ō rātou hoa hoki. He ara tēnei hei hono, hei whakawhiti kōrero, hei āwhina i te hunga e hiahia ana ki te whai wāhi.

Engari, i tētahi atu taha, he nui te tangata e whakaputa ana i tētahi ahua kāore e tino tika ana. Ka huri te tangata ki tētahi "ahua" e pai ake ana i tō rātou tūturu, nā te mea e hiahia ana rātou ki te whiwhi i ngā "like", i ngā kōrero pai rānei. Ka taea e tēnei te whakaputa i te mate pūngao, te whakapono kore, me te whakapae i te tūponotanga o te whakamā.

Nō reira, me mātua whakaaro te tangata ki te tūturu, ki te pono hoki i te wā e whakaputa ana i a rātou anō ki te ao ipurangi. He pai ake te whakaputa i te tūturu, ahakoa he iti, he nui rānei, i te whakaputa i tētahi mea kāore e tino tika ana. Ko te pono te tino hua o te whakapapa.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How can I reduce my carbon footprint?

response:
Hei whakaiti i tō pūtake waro (carbon footprint), ka taea e koe te whakapau kaha ki ēnei mahi:

1.  **Whakamātautau i te wāhanga haerere:** Whakamahia te waka tūroro, te waka rererangi, te haere tū, te hīkoi rānei i te wā e taea ana. Mēnā me hoko waka, whiriwhiria he waka hiko, he waka hauwai rānei.

2.  **Whakaiti i te hiko:** Tangohia ngā taputapu mai i te pūhiko ina kāore e whakamahia ana. Whakamahia ngā tīrama LED, me te whakatika i te pūmahana o tō whare kia tika.

3.  **Whakakore i te kai:** Kaua e heke te kai. Hoko kai mai i ngā puna ā-rohe, ā, kaua e hoko kai kua pakaru.

4.  **Whakamahi i ngā rauemi kua whakamahia:** Whakamahi i ngā kete, i ngā pouaka, i ngā kēmu rānei kua whakamahia kē. Kaua e hoko i ngā mea hou mēnā ka taea te whakamahi i ngā mea tawhito.

5.  **Whakaputa i te wai:** Whakaiti i te wā e takahuri ana, me te whakamahi i ngā taputapu whakapau wai iti.

6.  **Whakauru i te whakaputa:** Whakauru i ngā mea kua whakamahia kē ki roto i ngā kete whakaputa, kaua ki te tapahi.

Mā ēnei mahi, ka taea e koe te whakaiti i te pūtake waro, me te āwhina i te taiao.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What are the key steps to starting a garden?

response:
Anei ngā hātepe matua hei tīmata i tō whare pūtaiao:

1.  **Tīpakohia te wāhi tika:** Kimihia tētahi wāhi e whiwhi ana i te mārama o te rā (he nui te hiahia o ngā rākau kai ki te 6-8 hāora o te rā i ia rā).
2.  **Tirohia te whenua:** Tātaihia te momo whenua o tō wāhi. He nui rānei te kirikiri, he parakore rānei? Me whakapai ake te whenua mā te tāpiri i te kōmaru (compost) kia pai ai te pāpā.
3.  **Whakatau i ō kai:** Whiriwhiria ngā hua, ngā hua rākau rānei e hiahia ana koe ki te tipu. Whakaarohia te wā o te tau me te hāora o te rā e hiahiatia ana e ia tipu.
4.  **Hunaia te whenua:** Mā te whakamahi i te rakau, te haka rānei, whakawhānuihia te whenua kia rite ai ki te whakatipū. Whakakorengia ngā matū e kore e hiahiatia ana.
5.  **Whakaputa i ngā hua:** Ka taea te whakaputa i ngā hua i roto i ngā ipu i te whare, kātahi ka whakaputa ki te whenua ina rānei rātou, ka whakaputa hoki i te whenua tonu.
6.  **Waiho:** Me waiho ngā tipu i te wā tika. He nui te hiahia o ngā tipu ki te wai, engari kaua e waiho kia rereke te wai.
7.  **Aroha ki ngā tipu:** Kia maere, kia whakakorengia ngā matū e kore e hiahiatia ana, kia tautoko hoki i ngā tipu ina tipu rā

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How would you describe the feeling of making a positive difference in the world?

response:
He mihi nui tēnei whakamārama mō te āhuatanga o te hanga i tētahi rerekētanga pai ki te ao.

Ko te whakaputa i tētahi hua pai ki te ao, he **whakamārama** tōna, he **pūmau** hoki. Ka rite ki te whakaputa i te aho ki te pō, ka puta mai he mārama, he wāhi hoki hei whakatika i te huarahi mō ētahi atu.

He **hāpai** te āhua o tēnei. Ka kitea te kaha o te whānau, te iwi rānei, i te wā e whakapau kaha ana koe ki te tautoko i a rātou. He **aroha** nui tēnei, he **whakapono** hoki ki te āpōpō. Ka mōhio koe, ahakoa he iti noa iho tō mahi, he nui tonu tō pānga ki te oranga o te taiao, ki te hauora o te tangata, ki te oranga o te whenua.

He **kaha** te ngākau i roto i tēnei mahi. Ka rite ki te rā e tū ana i runga i te pae, ka wera, ka whakamārama, ka whakapiki i te hinengaro. He **whakapono** tēnei ki te aroha, ki te whanaungatanga, ki te tūponotanga.

I te mutunga, he **hōhonu** te whakapono i roto i tēnei. Ka mōhio koe, he nui te kaha o te tangata ki te huri i te ao, he nui hoki te kaha o te aroha ki te whakatika i ngā raruraru. He **mārama** tēnei, he **pūmau**, he **aroha** hoki.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What's your perspective on equal access to mental health services across all communities?

response:
He mea tino nui te whai whakaae ki ngā ratonga hauora hinengaro mō ngā hapori katoa. Ko te tino whakaaro ko te kore e tika kia rerekē te whai wāhi ki te āwhina, ahakoa he aha te taumata, te wāhi noho, te reo, te ariā rānei o te tangata.

Mēnā ka whakawātea ngā ratonga ki ngā katoa, ka kaha ake te whakapono o te iwi, ka heke te tohu o te mate hinengaro, ā, ka hua mai he hapori kaha, hauora hoki. Me whakarite kia rite ngā rautaki, kia whai whakaaro hoki ki ngā tikanga Māori, kia taea ai te āwhina i ngā tūāpapa o te iwi. Ko te tōrunga o te hauora hinengaro he tika tangata, ehara i te taonga mō ētahi anake.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do you determine what constitutes a quality contribution to society?

response:
He mea nui te whakatau i te tino uara o te tautoko ki te hapori, ā, ka taea te titiro ki ēnei āhuatanga matua:

Tuatahi, me whai hua te mahi ki te whakapiki i te oranga o te hunga katoa, kaua ko te hunga kotahi. Mēnā ka whakaiti te mahi i te mate, ka whakapiki i te hauora, ka whakatairanga i te ako, ka whakakaha rānei i te hononga i waenganui i te iwi, he tino tautoko tērā.

Tuarua, me whai mana te mahi ki te noho tonu. Ehara i te mea he whakataunga tino poto, engari he mahi e taea ana te tipu, te whanaketanga, me te whakaputa i ngā hua pai mō ngā whakatipuranga e heke mai ana.

Tuarua, me hāngai ki ngā uara o te hapori, pērā i te manaakitanga, te kotahitanga, me te tino tika. Me whakamahi i te rangatiratanga o te tangata ki te whakatika i ngā raru, kaua ki te whakapiki ake i te riri.

Whakamutunga, me whakaaro ki te tino hiahia o te iwi. Ko te tautoko tino pai, ko te mea e whakakī ana i ngā awangawanga o te hapori, e whakaputa ana i te rangimarie, e whakakaha ana i te wairua, ā, e whakaputa ana i te aroha ki te taiao me te tangata.

Ko te tino tautoko ki te hapori, ko te mahi e whakapiki ana i te mana o te iwi, e whakapiki ana i te oranga, e whakapiki ana i te hononga, ā, e whakapiki ana i te aroha ki te taiao.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What is the significance of leaving a positive legacy?

response:
Ko te whakawhiwhi i tētahi oranga pai he mea tino nui nā te mea ka tohatoha tēnei ki ngā whakatipuranga e heke mai ana. Mā te mahi pai, mā te aroha, mā te whakahaere i te taiao me te whakapāpāho i ngā mōhiotanga, ka waiho he huarahi mō te hunga e noho mai nei.

Ko te tikanga o te oranga pai, ko te whakaputa i ngā mahi e whakanui ana i te mana o te iwi, e whakakotahi ana i te hapori, ā, e pupuri ana i te wāhi mō te ao tūroa. Mā te waiho i tētahi oranga pai, ka kitea e te hunga e heke mai ana he tauira pai, he kaha, he mōhio hoki ki te whakapau kaha mō te pai o te motu katoa. Hei whakamutunga, ko te oranga pai te tohu o te aroha me te whakapono ki te wā e heke mai nei.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How would you describe what it's like to feel truly understood by someone?

response:
He mea tino pūmau, he mea tino waiora te whakapono i te tangata e mōhio ana ia ki a koe. Ko te hāora i te hinengaro, te riro mai i te mahana o te manawa, me te kite i a koe i roto i tō kanohi, ahakoa kāore he kupu e pāngia ana.

Ka ngaro te pakitara i waenganui i a koe me tērā atu. Kāore he hiahia kia whakamārama pūmau, kia whakapae rānei i ō whakaaro; kei te mōhio tōna hinengaro ki ō hihiko, ki ō pouri, ki ō hiahia hoki. He mea nui tēnei, he mea tino waiora, he mea tino pūmau, he mea tino waiora.

Ka tū te tangata i roto i te aroha, i te whakapono, i te whakaaro nui. He mea tino pūmau, he mea tino waiora te whakapono i te tangata e mōhio ana ia ki a koe.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
I'm dealing with racial discrimination at work and feel powerless to change it.

response:
He tino paitini tēnei āhuatanga, ā, he tino whakamā, he tino pōuri hoki te mea e noho ana koe i tētahi taiao pēnei. Ko te mea he tika rawa atu, he hē te whakahaere i a koe pēnei. Ahakoa he nui te kaha o te riri, he nui te kaha o te whakapono, me whakapono koe: **kāore koe i te kotahi**, ā, **he hē te mahi a ō hoa mahi, ehara i te mea he hē tōu.**

Anei ētahi hātepe e taea ana e koe te whakaaro mōna, kia kore ai koe e noho i te kore kaha:

1.  **Tuhia ngā take:** Whakaputa mai i ngā tūāhua katoa i puta mai, me te rā, te wā, me ngā kaiwhakapā. Mēnā ka whai whakaaro koe ki te whakapā atu ki te mana, me whai pūtaiao koe.
2.  **Whakawhānuitia tō tautoko:** Kimihia tētahi hoa mahi e tino whakapono ana ki a koe, tētahi kaiārahi, tētahi kaiwhakahaere, rānei. Mēnā kāore he tangata i roto i te kamupene, whakapā atu ki te **Te Taura Whiri i te Rārangi** (Human Rights Commission) i Aotearoa, nō te mea he ture tēnei e whakamārama ana i te whakakorenga i te whakapae i te taunakitanga.
3.  **Whakapā atu ki ngā ture:** Kei Aotearoa, kei raro i te **Ture Whakamarumaru Tangata (Human Rights Act 1993)** me te **Ture Mahi (Employment Relations Act 2000)** te ture e whakamārama ana i te whakakorenga i te whakapae i te taun

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What would you tell someone who has lost hope?

response:
Kia ora e hoa. Kei te mōhio au he uaua te ara ina kore e kitea te rama, ā, he tino pouri te aroaro o te ngaro o te hua. Heoi, me whakaaro noa koe ki ēnei kupu:

Ko te ngaro o te hua, ehara i te mutunga o tō hītori. He wā tēnei, ehara i te ao katoa. Ka huri ngā āhuatanga, ka huri ngā rangi, ā, ka puta anō te rā i muri i te pō tōmuri.

Kei roto i a koe te kaha ki te whakahōu, ahakoa he iti noa iho te tohu. Me whakapono ki a koe anō, me whakapono hoki ki te wā e heke mai nei. He aha rānei te mea tino nui? Ko te oranga tonu o a koe i tēnei wā. Ko te oranga tonu, he tohu nui tēnei o te hua.

Me mōhio koe, ehara koe i te takitahi. Kei reira ētahi e aroha ana ki a koe, e hiahia ana ki te āwhina i a koe, me te whakarongo ki a koe. Me tuku ki a rātou kia tū mai ki tō taha.

Whakapono mai, ka puta anō te rā. Kia kaha, kia mau tonu te hua ki a koe.

response:
Ko te whakahou (recycling) he tukanga hei whakahuri i ngā mea kua kore e hiahiatia kia rite anō kia taea ai te whakamahi. Hei whakatau i te tukanga:

Tuatahi, ka **whakarōpū** ngā tāngata i ō rātou para ki ngā ipu motuhake, pēnei i te kōpara, te kirihou, me te konumohe. Ko te tūponotanga o te tika o tēnei wāhanga he mea nui rawa, nā te mea me wehe ngā momo matū kia kore ai e pāheke.

Kātahi, ka tango te kamupene para i ngā ipu kua rāpua, ā, ka tuku ki te **pūnaha wehenga**. I konei, ka whakamahia ngā mīhini me ngā tangata hei wehe i ngā mea i runga i tō rātou momo, i tō rātou rahi, me tō rātou āhua. Ka tangohia ngā mea kāore e taea te whakahou, pērā i ngā tīwae tino whara.

I muri i te wehenga, ka **whakakī** ngā matū ki roto i ngā rīpeka, ka whakapēhi, ka wera rānei kia taea ai te kapi i ngā momo matū hou. Mēnā he konumohe, ka whakarewaia kia taea ai te hanga i ngā konumohe hou. Mēnā he kirihou, ka hurihia hei ngota, hei rīpeka rānei.

Whakamutunga, ka tuku ngā kamupene hanga i ēnei matū hou ki te **whakaputa** i ngā hua hou, pērā i ngā pūtihi, ngā kōpaki, me ngā tīwae. Ka hoki mai ēnei hua ki te maakete, ā, ka whakamahi anō ngā kaiwhakamahi.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.

response:

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do you choose experiences that bring you joy?

response: Hei kōwhiri i ngā wheako e tuku harikoa mai ana, me whakarongo ki taku ringa, ki taku hinengaro rānei. Ko te mea tuatahi, me titiro ki ngā mea e hiahia ana ahau ki te mahi, ahakoa he nui, he iti rānei. Ko te mea tuarua, me whakaaro ki ngā wā i mua i te wā i whai hua ai ahau, i harikoa ai ahau. Mēnā he wheako e tuku pānga pai ana ki taku hinengaro, ki taku tinana, ki taku wairua rānei, ka kōwhiria e ahau. He mea nui hoki te noho tahi ki ngā hoa, ki te whānau, ki te iwi rānei, nā te mea he nui te harikoa e tae mai ana i te noho tahi. Ko te whakamutunga, me kōwhiri i ngā mea e hāngai ana ki ōku uara, ki ōku whāinga, kia pai ai te ora.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How do technological innovations influence artistic expression?

response:
He nui te pānga o ngā hōhonutanga hangarau ki te whakaatu i te toi. Ko te hangarau he rauemi hou mō ngā toi, he ara hou hoki hei tuku i ngā whakaaro.

Tuatahi, ka whakaritea e te hangarau ngā tikanga hou. Mō te tauira, ka taea e ngā kaitoi te hanga toi rorohiko, te whakamahi i te pūtaiao rorohiko (AI) hei hanga whakaahua, me te whakamahi i te pūtaiao tino tino (VR) hei whakauru i te kaiwhakaaro ki roto i te ao toi. Kāore i taea enei āhuatanga i mua.

Tuarua, ka whakanui te hangarau i te tuku i te toi. Mā te ipurangi, ka taea e te kaitoi te tuku i tōna mahi ki te ao katoa i te wā kotahi. Kāore he here ā-rohe, ā, ka taea e ngā tangata katoa te kite, te rongo, me te whakawhitiwhiti mō te toi.

Tuarima, ka whakaputa te hangarau i ngā mahi toi hou e kore e taea te hanga ki ngā tikanga tawhito. Ko te whakawhitinga mai i te hoahoa ki te mahi toi, ko te whakamahi i te pūtaiao whakaata, me te whakamahi i te pūtaiao tūtohu katoa he wāhanga nui o te ao toi o nāianei.

Heoi, he whakataetae hoki tēnei. Me whakaaro ngā kaitoi mō te noho tonu o te tangata i roto i te mahi toi, kia kaua te hangarau hei whakakapi i te wairua tangata, engari hei whakanui i te wairua tangata. Ko te hangarau he taputapu anake, ko te kaitoi tonu te kaituku i te whakaaro me te hinengaro.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
How should we approach questions about the nature of existence?

response:
Me whai whakaaro tātou ki ngā pātai mō te āhua o te ora mā te tirohanga o te whanaungatanga me te hononga.

Ko te tikanga, kāore te tangata e noho kotahi; he wāhanga tātou o te ao katoa, o te whenua, o te rangi, me ngā tūpuna. Me pātai tātou: "He aha tāku hononga ki tēnei taiao?" me "He pēhea te mahi a te ao kia noho haere ai tātou?"

Me tūhura mā te whakarongo, mā te aroha, me te mārama ki ngā tikanga tuku iho. Ko te whakautu kāore e kitea i roto i te aroaro anake, engari i roto i te oranga tahi, i te kaha o te whānau, me te tūponotanga o te whenua. Me āta whakaaro, me āta kōrero, kia puta mai ai te mōhiohio e hāngai ana ki te oranga tonutanga o te ao.

messages.content: Always answer in Māori. Do not use any other language.
What makes certain human rights universal and unchanging?

response:
